description: An invoice — photo, PDF or the CFE's XML — becomes one row of data; whatever could not be read comes back empty and flagged
client_copy: Pasa la foto o el PDF de tus facturas a la planilla —fecha, proveedor, número y monto— y te muestra lo que no pudo leer antes de que cuente.
_comment: THE THREE ACCOUNTING FLOWS ARE THIS PLUGIN'S, and only the first one names
the skill in its frontmatter. `planilla-del-mes` runs it; `conciliar-cobros`
crosses what was invoiced against what came in and `facturas-vencidas`
reads the due dates -- both over the ROWS this skill produces (fecha,
proveedor, número, monto). Without it there is no table to reconcile or to
read a due date off, so the ownership is the data's and not the frontmatter's.
